description:
Read saved answers for an existing workspace registration.

        Returns private applicant fields, address and available sender information.
        An older application without saved answers returns 404.
        A number registration (``purpose="number"``) returns its kept answers,
        ``documents`` and the kept ``files`` by name (without their bytes) until
        ``kept_until``; ``resubmit_verification`` files it again from them.
        This read can recover an existing sender's details but creates no brand and files no campaign.
        Corrections retain the existing registration and its paid identity.

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

verification_id.description: ID of the original registration, from ``list_verifications``: an SMS one, including one needing corrections, or a rejected number one.
verification_id.title: Verification Id

name: get_sms_application

city.description: City or town of the street address, as written on mail sent there.
city.title: City

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code of the street address, such as `94103`.
postal_code.title: Postal Code

KeptDocumentAnswer.description: A document slot's saved choice on a number registration.
KeptDocumentAnswer.title: KeptDocumentAnswer

KeptFileInfo.description: A file Hail keeps for a resubmit. The bytes are never returned.

filename.description: The file name as it was sent.
filename.title: Filename

slot.description: The document slot it was filed for.
slot.title: Slot

KeptFileInfo.title: KeptFileInfo

anyOf.description:
Private saved answers of a registration: a US texting application
(or verified sender details for an old filing), or a number
registration kept for a resubmit.

documents.description: Number registration only: each document slot's option and fields, by slot name. Null for US texting.
documents.title: Documents

fields.description: Saved application answers; legacy responses may contain only verified sender details.
fields.title: Fields

files.description: Number registration only: the files Hail keeps, by slot. A resubmit reuses each one unless you send a new file for its slot.
files.title: Files

hold_cents.description: Number registration only: the credit a resubmit with that quote sets aside (its setup and first month). Null when nothing is set aside or the quote is gone.
hold_cents.title: Hold Cents

kept_until.description: Number registration only: when Hail deletes these answers and files.
kept_until.title: Kept Until

quote_id.description: Number registration only: the quote it was filed for. It keeps working with GET /v1/verifications/requirements and the resubmit while the answers are kept.
quote_id.title: Quote Id

schema_version.description: Version of this saved-answer response format.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

subject_type.description: Original sender route: person or business.
subject_type.title: Subject Type

anyOf.title: SmsApplicationResponse

title: Read saved SMS application
